title: Phase II trial of PARP inhibitor + chemotherapy in BRCA-mutated ovarian cancer
snippet: Randomized phase II trial; combination arm met the primary progression-free survival endpoint versus monotherapy control.
outcome: combination arm improved progression-free survival vs monotherapy

title: SGLT2 inhibitor add-on in resistant hypertension with heart failure risk
snippet: Trial met secondary endpoint of reduced heart-failure hospitalization at 12 months; blood pressure reduction was statistically significant.
outcome: reduced heart-failure hospitalization and blood pressure

title: Metformin extended-release vs immediate-release: glycemic outcomes in type 2 diabetes
snippet: Extended-release arm showed non-inferior HbA1c reduction with significantly fewer GI adverse events than immediate-release arm.
outcome: extended-release non-inferior on glycemic control, better tolerability

title: Metformin extended-release: real-world glycemic control cohort study
snippet: Real-world cohort found extended-release metformin underperformed immediate-release on HbA1c reduction in patients with baseline eGFR below 60.
outcome: extended-release underperformed immediate-release in reduced-renal-function patients

title: Anti-amyloid antibody trial in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease
snippet: Trial met primary endpoint on composite cognitive decline scale at 18 months versus placebo.

title: Phase I safety trial of broad-spectrum antiviral candidate
snippet: Phase I trial reported no serious adverse events at therapeutic dose range; pharmacokinetics supported once-daily dosing.
outcome: acceptable safety profile, supports once-daily dosing
